description: Bi wol rabbit ninja combat idle key pose B. Draw the EXACT same character and crisp native pixel style from reference ONE but in a LOWER shallow combat crouch, facing SOUTH-EAST three-quarter FRONT. Use reference TWO ONLY for visibly bent knees and lowered pelvis, NEVER its hands, weapon position, ears or appearance. Keep reference ONE's head/ear design, calm face if visible, cream fur, plum outfit, red scarf, gear, small low dagger in right hand, empty other hand raised as guard. Both feet remain at the same ground positions as reference ONE; thighs angle outward, knees bend, pelvis drops and the head/torso sit lower, like a quiet compressed spring. It is a restrained idle endpoint, not an attack and not a deep squat. Preserve the same head size and overall native scale, leave a little MORE empty space above the ears because the body is lower. No jump, no new weapon, no VFX, no background. One whole-body 64x64 pixel sprite per candidate, transparent background. Prioritize consistent character identity and lowered knee/hip anatomy over adding details.

reference_images.usage: PRIMARY: exact character identity, head and asymmetric ears, native proportions and pixel style, all costume and weapon details, facing direction. Change only the knee/hip/body pose to a lower idle.
SECONDARY: only the flexed knees and lowered pelvis/body posture. Ignore its ear, hand, weapon positions and design differences; take those from PRIMARY.
